description: Whether the gate publishes its verdict as the tower/gate check run on the exact head it judged, apart from the comment panel (gate.status_enabled): pending at begin, success or failure from the verdict, no comment, no gate.started and no verdict hooks. forge-events.status_enabled still turns every write off; forge-events.check_run_publisher chooses who posts it (D-299). On since D-313: the infra judge (delivery.judge=infra) publishes it too, through gate_status.check_hooks, before the landing.
